toolRepairs.context: 4naly3er failed outright on the first two attempts. Both failures were silent-ish and would have been easy to misreport as 'tool unavailable'. Recorded here in full because the fixes change the tool's state.

failure1.symptom: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'nodeType') at src/issues/NC/uselessOverride.ts:15
failure1.misleading: The crash names an AST-walking style detector, which reads like a parser incompatibility. It is not.
failure1.rootCause: src/compile.ts builds its candidate compiler list from the `solc-*` keys in package.json and selects with semver.satisfies(version, pragma). The newest bundled compiler was solc-0.8.26 and the pragma is ^0.8.27, so filteredSources was empty for EVERY version, no compile promise was ever created, and compileAndBuildAST returned an array of undefined ASTs. The subsequent crash was the first detector to dereference one. No 'Cannot compile AST' message is printed on this path, so the real cause is silent.
failure1.isolationEvidence: Running each of the 6 files alone crashed identically, proving it was tool-level, not file-specific.
failure1.sideEffects: Modifies tools/4naly3er/package.json and yarn.lock and adds node_modules/solc-0.8.27. LEFT IN PLACE - it is strictly additive and any future ^0.8.27 project needs it. tools/4naly3er is its own git repo, so `git checkout package.json yarn.lock` reverts it.
failure1.preExistingLocalMods: tools/4naly3er already carried uncommitted local modifications to package.json, yarn.lock and src/compile.ts before this run (a longest-prefix remapping fix in findImports). Not authored by this run.

failure2.symptom: `lib/vault/src/interfaces/IYieldStrategy.sol import not found`, then a solc wasm crash
failure2.rootCause: PhusdStableMinter.sol is pulled in via the `@phUSDMinter/=lib/phUSD-stable-minter/src/` remapping, so its source unit name keeps the remapping prefix. Its relative import `../lib/vault/src/interfaces/IYieldStrategy.sol` therefore resolves against that prefix to `lib/vault/...` rather than to `lib/phUSD-stable-minter/lib/vault/...`. 4naly3er's naive findImports cannot recover the real path, and the workspace remappings.txt held only the 4 top-level entries.
failure2.fix: Wrote an augmented remappings.txt at BASE_PATH: the full `forge remappings` output (15 entries) plus 4 shim entries mapping the nested-dep prefixes (lib/vault/, lib/pauser/, lib/flax-token/, lib/mutable/) onto their real locations under lib/phUSD-stable-minter/.
failure2.sideEffects: workspace/antimatter/remappings.txt was temporarily overwritten and RESTORED to its original 4-line content after the run. remappings.txt is untracked/generated in the workspace; lib/antimatter was never touched.
failure2.orderingNote: Slither, Aderyn and Semgrep had all already completed before remappings.txt was touched, so none of their results are affected.

semgrepRulesetAssessment.verdict: NO SECURITY VALUE, confirming the recorded trap for a second consecutive run. p/smart-contracts is a gas/style ruleset. Zero rules of WARNING or ERROR severity fired, and the ruleset contains no Solidity vulnerability detectors. A clean or near-clean Semgrep run on this repo is evidence of NOTHING and must not be cited as one. 41 of 42 results severity-mapped to discard; the single exception (use-ownable2step) is retained only as corroboration of 4naly3er L-2/L-12 in finding SA-014.
semgrepRulesetAssessment.noBetterRulesetAvailable: No Solidity security ruleset exists in the Semgrep registry; this is the same conclusion reached in run-01.
